senses.gloss:
पिट् पिट्, cl. 1. P. पेटति, पेटितुम्, to
sound; to assemble or heap together.

पिट, अस्, m. a basket for holding grain, a sort of
cupboard or granary made of bamboos or canes; a
basket, box; (अम्), n. a house, a hovel; a roof.

पिटक, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. (usually n.), a basket,
box; a large basket or receptacle of basket-work for
keeping grain &c., a granary; a collection of writings
[cf. त्रि-प्˚]; a boil, blister, ulcer; a kind of orna-
ment on Indra's banner; (अस्), m., N. of a man.

पिटाक, see Gaṇa to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 49; (अस्), m.,
N. of a man; N. of a sage.

पिट्टक पिट्टक, अम्, n. the tartar or excre-
tion of the teeth; [cf. किट्ट, किट्टक, पिप्पिका.]
पिटक्या, f. a multitude of baskets.

पिटङ्काकी पिटङ्काकी or पिटङ्कोकी, f. the
plant Cucumis Colocynthis.

पिटङ्काश पिटङ्काश, अस्, m. a kind of fish,
a species of pike, Esax Scolopax, Silurus Pabda.

पिट्टय पिट्टय (fr. पिट्ट = पिष्ट?), Nom.
P. पिट्टयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to stamp or press into a
solid mass.

पिट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, stamped into a solid mass,
pressed flat.

पीटिका पीटिका, a various reading for
पीठिका, q. v.
